name: What materials are commonly used for multi-level deck construction and what are their pros and cons?

mainEntity.name: What materials are commonly used for multi-level deck construction and what are their pros and cons?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials include pressure-treated lumber, composite decking, and natural hardwoods like cedar or redwood. Pressure-treated lumber is cost-effective and readily available, but requires regular maintenance. Composite decking offers low maintenance and durability, but typically has a higher upfront cost. Hardwoods provide natural beauty and longevity, but can be more expensive and may require specialized installation and care. Choosing the right material involves a practical tradeoff between budget, aesthetics, and long-term maintenance commitments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Materials include pressure-treated lumber (affordable, needs maintenance), composite (low maintenance, higher cost), and hardwoods (beautiful, expensive, specific care).
